Hello!
Thank you for requesting information from Orlando Health Orthopedic Institute! If you'd like to schedule an appointment with an orthopedic specialist, we've made it easy through our Request a Consultation website.
http://www.orlandohealthphysicians.com/orthopedics/RequestAConsultation
All you need to do is provide some basic information including your name, birthdate, phone number, address and contact information. Then a representative will contact you within 48 hours to confirm your appointment date and time. It's that easy!
Once your appointment is confirmed, you'll want to have a few things ready for your visit:
- You may want a family member or friend to accompany you and help remember the information you discuss with your physician - Your insurance information - A list of questions you want to ask the physician - Request any relevant medical records from your health care provider
If you have questions about finding a physician, you can reach us at 321.841.3724.
